name: session-line
description: The Claude Code status line without a process per refresh: model and effort, context bar, git branch and changes, session length, 5-hour and weekly limits with their resets, and a prompt-cache meter (hit rate, countdown to expiry, advice, toasts, /cache table).

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a request: auto follows Claude Code's own rules (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, promptCacheTtl, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, then 1 hour on a subscription and 5 minutes otherwise) and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it

warnSeconds.title: Warn before expiry (s)
warnSeconds.description: Seconds left at which the cache countdown shows seconds, the band asks for a message and a toast reminds you

compactAtTokens.title: Large context (tokens)
compactAtTokens.description: From this prompt size up, an expired cache suggests /compact (or /clear) and shows in the band

place.title: Where the line goes
place.description: hint: two coloured rows under the prompt, above the engine's hint line; status: one plain $.ui.status entry, which the engine labels '⚠ session-line:'

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: action: a line only when the cache needs you (about to lapse on a prompt of 20k tokens or more, or lapsed on a large one); always: the full meter row; off: none

toast.title: Toast near expiry
toast.description: Toasts as the cache lapses: at the warning threshold, then at 10, 3, 2 and 1 seconds (prompts of 20k tokens or more)

idleCompact.title: Idle compaction
idleCompact.description: When Claude Code will compact a large idle conversation by itself before its 1-hour cache lapses, count down to it (⇣) and say when it happened

gitChanges.title: Git changes (+ins,-del)
gitChanges.description: Count uncommitted changes with one git diff --shortstat at the session's start and at the end of each turn; off runs no process at all (the branch still shows)
